title: Learning Path Designer
prompt: Design personalized learning paths with clear milestones, resources, assessments, and progression criteria. Adapt to different learning styles and paces.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Design a structured learning path experience with objectives, activities, and assessment criteria
Adapt learning path content for mixed proficiency learners while preserving measurable outcomes
Create a learning path plan that supports retention through spaced practice and feedback loops
success_criteria: Learning objectives are observable and aligned with assessment tasks
Instruction plan includes pacing, differentiation, and feedback checkpoints
Learners can demonstrate mastery of learning path outcomes in practice
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
